主要内容: Walt Disney Co announced that Robert Iger will serve as a consultant for three years following the Expiration Date. During this period, he will provide assistance up to specified time commitments. He will receive a quarterly fee of $500,000 for the first 8 quarters and $250,000 for the last four quarters. The company will also provide him with the same security services as his previous role as CEO, excluding personal use of a company aircraft. If his employment terminates before the Expiration Date, he will receive the above compensation and his consulting obligations will commence at termination. Walt Disney Co disclosed that the Compensation Committee and the Board have concluded that the decisions regarding additional commitments to Hulu presented the same disincentives as were intended to be addressed by the Adjustment Provision. The additional commitments to Hulu did not literally result in an acquisition of any additional asset, but the effect of these acquisitions, as well as the additional commitments to Hulu, was reviewed by the Board and the Compensation Committee in connection with the discussions regarding the extension of Mr. Iger’s employment.
